text: The SATA group is ultimately controlled by the Portuguese Autonomous Region of the Azores; the group's privatisation of Azores Airlines (sale of at least 75% of its capital) was still running in September 2026.
short: The European Commission: the SATA group is ultimately controlled by the Autonomous Region of the Azores

source.name: European Commission press release: State aid: Commission approves €453.25 million Portuguese restructuring aid in favour of SATA Group (IP/22/3525)
source.quote: SATA Group is a regional airline ultimately controlled by the Portuguese Autonomous Region of Azores.

additionalSources.name: Azores Airlines: SATA Holding recebe oito manifestações de interesse
additionalSources.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. English: 'At issue is the disposal of at least 75% of the company's share capital.' The notice refers to the expression-of-interest deadline of 6 September 2026, so the privatisation was still running then. Reuters (via O Jornal/Herald News, 8 Sept 2026) adds that SATA Holding 'is owned by the Azores regional government'.
additionalSources.quote: Em causa está a alienação de, pelo menos, 75% do capital social da empresa
